questions.q: Who took charge as Managing Director and CEO of HDFC Bank on 27 October 2026?
questions.explanation: Anup Bagchi took charge on 27 October 2026 after RBI approved a three-year term. He succeeded Sashidhar Jagdishan, whose tenure ended on 26 October 2026, and came from ICICI Prudential Life Insurance. Source: Business Today, 27 Oct 2026.

questions.q: In October 2026, the RBI approved whom as MD and CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank for three years from 1 January 2027?
questions.explanation: RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha, a whole-time director of the bank and former Bajaj Finance executive, for three years from 1 January 2027. He will succeed Ashok Vaswani, whose term ends on 31 December 2026. Source: ThePrint (Bloomberg), 1 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who took over as the Chief of the Army Staff on 30 June 2026, succeeding General Upendra Dwivedi?
questions.explanation: General Dhiraj Seth, an Armoured Corps officer commissioned in December 1986, took over on 30 June 2026. He is the first Armoured Corps officer to head the Army since 1997, and his tenure runs to August 2028. Source: Free Press Journal (IANS), 30 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Who took charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026?
questions.explanation: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit took charge on 31 October 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, who retired after 42 years of service. Dixit was earlier Vice Chief of the Air Staff and was commissioned in the fighter stream in 1986. Source: All India Radio News, 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who became the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 20 July 2026 after Keir Starmer resigned?
questions.explanation: Andy Burnham became Prime Minister on 20 July 2026 after Keir Starmer resigned; he had been elected Leader of the Labour Party on 16 July 2026. He was earlier Mayor of Greater Manchester and returned to Parliament by winning the Makerfield by-election in June 2026. Source: GOV.UK, 20 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Who was sworn in as Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026?
questions.explanation: Congress leader D.K. Shivakumar was sworn in on 3 June 2026 by Governor Thaawarchand Gehlot, succeeding Siddaramaiah, who resigned on 28 May 2026. G. Parameshwara took oath as Deputy Chief Minister. Karnataka's Governor since 16 October 2026 is Sudha Yadav. Source: All India Radio News, 3 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Mahesh Muralidhar Pai, earlier a Chief General Manager at Canara Bank, became MD and CEO of which private sector bank from 1 October 2026?
questions.explanation: RBI approved Pai as MD & CEO of South Indian Bank for three years from 1 October 2026; he succeeded P.R. Seshadri. The bank is headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Source: Business Standard, 8 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Who was appointed Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India with effect from 1 October 2026 to look after the Department of Supervision?
questions.explanation: RBI appointed Sudhakar Malli, earlier Chief General Manager-in-Charge of the Department of Supervision, as Executive Director from 1 October 2026. Other EDs appointed in 2026 include Ravi Shankar (1 July, Department of Statistics and Information Management), Monisha Chakraborty (3 August) and Suman Ray (1 September). Source: RBI press release 2026-2027/1241, 2 Oct 2026.

questions.q: In June 2026, the Centre re-appointed Swaminathan J as Deputy Governor of the RBI from 26 June 2026 for how long?
questions.explanation: Swaminathan J, a former SBI Managing Director, was re-appointed for two years from 26 June 2026. The RBI Act, 1934 provides for four Deputy Governors; the others are Poonam Gupta, S.C. Murmu and Rohit Jain. Source: RBI press release, 5 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Hitesh Rameshchandra Joshi was appointed Chairman-cum-Managing Director of which public sector company with effect from 16 June 2026?
options: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re)
questions.explanation: Hitesh Joshi was appointed CMD of GIC Re, India's national reinsurer, from 16 June 2026 until 30 September 2028. He had been interim CMD since 1 October 2025. GIC Re is headquartered in Mumbai. Source: Reinsurance News, 17 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Who took charge as Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Anurag Jain, a 1989-batch IAS officer of the Madhya Pradesh cadre, was appointed for two years in July 2026 and took charge on 17 August 2026. Nidhi Chhibber had held additional charge after B.V.R. Subrahmanyam's term ended. Source: Business Standard, 18 Aug 2026.

questions.q: S. Somanath, appointed a part-time non-official director on the RBI Central Board in August 2026, is a former chairman of which organisation?
questions.explanation: Former ISRO Chairman S. Somanath was appointed to the RBI Central Board for four years from 20 August 2026, and Anand Mahindra was re-appointed. Such directors are nominated under Section 8(1)(c) of the RBI Act, 1934. Source: AffairsCloud, 22 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Khalilur Rahman, who took office as President of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in September 2026, is from which country?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman took office on 8 September 2026, succeeding Germany's Annalena Baerbock (80th session). He was elected in June 2026, defeating Andreas Kakouris of Cyprus. Source: AffairsCloud, 4 Jun 2026.

questions.q: In the Governor appointments announced by the President on 12 October 2026, who was named Governor of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Former Lok Sabha MP Dr Sudha Yadav was named Governor of Karnataka, succeeding Thaawarchand Gehlot. The same order named Braj Mohan Ram for Odisha, Dhal Singh Bisen for Uttarakhand and Dushyant Gautam for Sikkim. Governors are appointed by the President under Article 155. Source: Organiser, 13 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Former Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar was approved by the RBI in July 2026 as part-time chairman of which bank?
questions.explanation: RBI approved Rajiv Kumar as part-time chairman of HDFC Bank for three years from 15 July 2026. He followed Atanu Chakraborty, who resigned in March 2026; Keki Mistry was interim chairman in between. Source: HDFC Bank filing, 15 Jul 2026.

questions.q: The UN Secretary-General, whose selection for the term starting 1 January 2027 was under way in November 2026, is appointed by the General Assembly on the recommendation of which body?
questions.explanation: Under Article 97 of the UN Charter, the General Assembly appoints the Secretary-General on the Security Council's recommendation. Antonio Guterres's term ends on 31 December 2026; no successor had been recommended by mid-November 2026. Source: Al Jazeera, 15 Nov 2026.

questions.q: In October 2026, who was appointed part-time Chairperson of the Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB) for three years?
questions.explanation: Retired IAS officer Subhash Chandra Lal (S.C.L.) Das was appointed FSIB Chairperson for three years from 16 October 2026. He succeeded Bhanu Pratap Sharma, whose extended tenure ended on 30 June 2026. FSIB recommends top appointments in public sector banks, financial institutions and insurers. Source: Indian Masterminds, 17 Oct 2026.

questions.q: After Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Union Education Minister on 25 July 2026, which Union Minister was given additional charge of the Ministry of Education?
questions.explanation: Pradhan resigned on 25 July 2026 amid protests over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak. Pralhad Joshi, who holds Consumer Affairs and New and Renewable Energy, got additional charge. This may change if a full-time minister is named. Source: AffairsCloud, 28 Jul 2026.

questions.q: In August 2026, the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet gave a one-year extension to which officer as Cabinet Secretary?
questions.explanation: T.V. Somanathan, Cabinet Secretary since August 2024, got a one-year extension and stays till 30 August 2027. Home Secretary Govind Mohan was also extended by a year to 22 August 2027. Source: Adda247, 6 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Who was elected President of the International Chess Federation (FIDE) on 26 September 2026?
questions.explanation: Kazakhstan's Timur Turlov was elected FIDE President on 26 September 2026, replacing Arkady Dvorkovich. Viswanathan Anand, who was interim President from July 2026, is Deputy President. FIDE is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. Source: Reuters, 26 Sep 2026 (via Wikipedia).

questions.q: Which Indian took over as interim President of FIDE in July 2026 after Arkady Dvorkovich suspended his duties?
questions.explanation: FIDE Deputy President Viswanathan Anand took charge as interim President on 24 July 2026 after Arkady Dvorkovich suspended his duties following EU sanctions. Anand is a five-time World Chess Champion. Timur Turlov was elected President on 26 September 2026, with Anand as Deputy President. Source: All India Radio News, 24 Jul 2026.

questions.q: In October 2026, the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approved whom as the next Chairman of ONGC, to succeed Arun Kumar Singh in December 2026?
questions.explanation: ONGC Executive Director Sunil Kumar was approved on 21 October 2026 and takes charge on or after 7 December 2026; Arun Kumar Singh's extended tenure ends on 6 December 2026, so Singh is still chairman in November. ONGC is a Maharatna under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. Source: Adda247, 23 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Jatin Kumar Nayak took charge as CMD of IREDA at the end of October 2026. IREDA works under which ministry?
options: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
questions.explanation: IREDA (Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency) is a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy. Jatin Kumar Nayak, earlier Executive Director (Finance) at REC, became its CMD on 30 October 2026. Source: Adda247, 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Monisha Chakraborty, appointed Executive Director of the RBI from 3 August 2026, looks after the Financial Markets Regulation Department and which other department?
options: Department of Statistics and Information Management
questions.explanation: Monisha Chakraborty became Executive Director on 3 August 2026 with charge of the Foreign Exchange Department and the Financial Markets Regulation Department. RBI is headquartered in Mumbai. Source: RBI press release 2026-2027/801, 3 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Suman Ray, who became an Executive Director of the RBI on 1 September 2026, was given charge of the Premises Department and the department dealing with which corporation?
options: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
questions.explanation: Suman Ray, earlier RBI Regional Director for Maharashtra, became Executive Director from 1 September 2026 and looks after the DICGC department and the Premises Department. DICGC insures deposits up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank. Source: RBI press release 2026-2027/1013, 1 Sep 2026.

questions.q: In October 2026, Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar was moved from Keralam (Kerala) to be the Governor of which state?
questions.explanation: Arlekar was appointed full-time Governor of Tamil Nadu on 12 October 2026; he had held its additional charge since March 2026. Om Prakash Mathur moved from Sikkim and was sworn in as the 29th Governor of Keralam. Source: Organiser, 13 Oct 2026.

questions.q: In August 2026, renewable energy company Hero Future Energies named which sportsperson as its brand ambassador?
questions.explanation: Hero Future Energies, the renewable energy arm of the Hero Group, appointed badminton player P.V. Sindhu on 17 August 2026. Sindhu won Olympic silver in 2016 and bronze in 2020. Source: Manifest Media, 17 Aug 2026.

questions.q: In September 2026, which Nobel laureate was named Chief Economist of the World Bank Group?
questions.explanation: World Bank President Ajay Banga named Michael Kremer, joint winner of the 2019 Economics Nobel, as Chief Economist and Senior Vice President for Development Economics from 1 October 2026. The World Bank is headquartered in Washington, D.C. Source: World Bank press release, 16 Sep 2026.

questions.q: Jensen Huang resigned as President and CEO of which company on 12 November 2026?
questions.explanation: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, resigned on 12 November 2026. CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones was named the first Chair of the Board. Source: NVIDIA Newsroom, 12 Nov 2026.

questions.q: Economist Neelkanth Mishra was approved in June 2026 as India's Executive Director at the World Bank. Whom does he succeed?
questions.explanation: The ACC approved Neelkanth Mishra, Chief Economist of Axis Bank, for three years; he succeeds Parameswaran Iyer. India's chair at the World Bank also represents Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka. Source: AffairsCloud, 5 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Who won the run-off of Brazil's presidential election held on 25 October 2026?
questions.explanation: President Lula won a fourth term with about 51.8% of the vote against Flavio Bolsonaro, after trailing in the first round on 4 October 2026. Geraldo Alckmin is his Vice-President. Brazil's capital is Brasilia. Source: AffairsCloud, 27 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who became the President of Bangladesh in August 2026 after Mohammed Shahabuddin resigned?
questions.explanation: BNP leader Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was elected by Parliament and has been President since 21 August 2026. Shahabuddin resigned on 24 July 2026 on health grounds. Tarique Rahman is the Prime Minister. Source: AffairsCloud, 22 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize 2026, announced in Oslo on 9 October 2026?
questions.explanation: South African jurist Navi Pillay won for promoting peace and international law. She was UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (2008-2014) and a judge of the International Criminal Court. Maria Corina Machado won in 2025. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Which bank was named the 'World's Best Consumer Bank 2026' by Global Finance magazine in July 2026?
questions.explanation: Global Finance named SBI the World's Best Consumer Bank for 2026. Santander was named World's Best Bank and DBS the World's Best Corporate Bank. The awards were presented in Bangkok on 17 October 2026 during the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings. Source: Global Finance, 16 Jul 2026.

questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded to which pair of economists?
options: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
questions.explanation: Robert E. Hall (Stanford) and Michael Woodford (Columbia), both American, won for the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation. The prize was announced on 12 October 2026. Mokyr, Aghion and Howitt won in 2025. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who won the Booker Prize 2026, announced in London in November 2026, for the novel 'The End of Everything'?
questions.explanation: British writer M. John Harrison won on 9 November 2026. At 81 he is the oldest winner, and his is the first science fiction work to win. The prize money is 50,000 pounds; Mary Beard chaired the judges. Source: AP, 10 Nov 2026.

questions.q: Which film won the Best Feature Film award at the 72nd National Film Awards, presented by the President in September 2026?
questions.explanation: 'Article 370' won Best Feature Film. 'Kalki 2898 AD' won the popular film award, 'Srikanth' was Best Hindi Film, and Rajkumar Periasamy won Best Direction for 'Amaran'. The awards were announced on 18 July 2026 for films of 2024. Source: News On AIR, 22 Sep 2026.

questions.q: Which veteran actor received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) at the 72nd National Film Awards on 22 September 2026?
questions.explanation: Kannada actor Anant Nag received the award from President Droupadi Murmu. The award was first given in 1969 to Devika Rani. Mohanlal received the previous award (for 2023). Source: News On AIR, 22 Sep 2026.

questions.q: In the National Sports Awards 2025, announced on 18 August 2026, which award was not given to anyone?
questions.explanation: The Sports Ministry named no Khel Ratna awardee for 2025, the first such year since 2014. It named 17 Arjuna awardees, including Tejaswin Shankar and Divya Deshmukh. The President gave the awards on 13 November 2026. Source: PTI/ThePrint, 18 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature 2026?
questions.explanation: Canadian poet, essayist and translator Anne Carson, born in Toronto, won the prize announced on 8 October 2026. Laszlo Krasznahorkai won in 2025 and Han Kang in 2024. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The Ramon Magsaysay Award, whose 2026 winners were announced on 31 August 2026, is named after a former President of which country?
questions.explanation: The award is named after Philippine President Ramon Magsaysay, who died in a plane crash in 1957. It was first given in 1958, is called Asia's Nobel Prize and is presented in Manila. Source: AP, 31 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Who among the following is one of the three winners of the Ramon Magsaysay Award 2026?
questions.explanation: The 2026 winners are Singapore diplomat Tommy Koh, Bangladeshi social worker Runa Khan and Myanmar activist Bo Kyi. Koh presided over the conference that adopted the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea in 1982. Source: AP, 31 Aug 2026.

questions.q: The prize in economic sciences in memory of Alfred Nobel, awarded in October 2026, was established in 1968 by which institution?
questions.explanation: Sweden's central bank, Sveriges Riksbank, set up the prize in 1968 for its 300th anniversary. It was first awarded in 1969. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences selects the winners. Source: Sveriges Riksbank.

questions.q: The 'Order of the White Double Cross (1st Class)', conferred on PM Narendra Modi in June 2026, is the highest state honour of which country?
questions.explanation: Slovak President Peter Pellegrini conferred the honour in Bratislava on 15 June 2026. It was reported as PM Modi's 33rd international honour. Source: IANS, 16 Jun 2026.

questions.q: In July 2026, PM Narendra Modi received Indonesia's highest civilian honour in Jakarta. What is it called?
options: Grand Collar of the Order of Timor-Leste
questions.explanation: President Prabowo Subianto conferred the Bintang Adipurna on 7 July 2026, reported as PM Modi's 35th international honour. The Order of the Druk Gyalpo is Bhutan's and the Order of Mubarak Al-Kabeer is Kuwait's. Source: PTI/OrissaPost, 7 Jul 2026.

questions.q: The 'Oliy Darajali Do'stlik' Order, conferred on PM Narendra Modi on 30 August 2026, is the highest honour for foreign leaders of which country?
questions.explanation: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev conferred it in Tashkent. PM Modi then went to Kyrgyzstan for the SCO summit. Source: PTI/Deccan Herald, 30 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Which bank was named 'India's Best Bank' in the Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2026?
questions.explanation: Euromoney named HDFC Bank India's best bank on 17 July 2026, citing 100 million customers and 9,616 branches. Santander was the world's best bank and HSBC was Asia's best bank. Source: Euromoney, 17 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Which film was selected in September 2026 as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards (Oscars 2027)?
questions.explanation: The Film Federation of India chose the Marathi film 'Gondhal', directed by Santosh Davakhar, from 33 films. It is the fourth Marathi entry after Shwaas, Harishchandrachi Factory and Court. 'Homebound' was the previous entry. Source: PTI/Onmanorama, 19 Sep 2026.

questions.q: How many gallantry awards did the President approve for armed forces and central police personnel on the eve of Independence Day 2026?
questions.explanation: President Murmu approved 78 gallantry awards on 14 August 2026, 13 of them posthumous. They include 9 Kirti Chakras and 19 Shaurya Chakras. The Kirti Chakra is the second-highest peacetime gallantry award after the Ashok Chakra. Source: PTI/ThePrint, 14 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Joheirry Mola, who was crowned Miss World 2026 in Vietnam on 5 September 2026, represents which country?
questions.explanation: She won the 73rd Miss World at Nha Trang, Vietnam, and was crowned by Opal Suchata Chuangsri of Thailand. Spain was first runner-up. India's Nikita Porwal reached the top 40. Source: Khaleej Times, 6 Sep 2026.

questions.q: R. Vairamuthu, who was chosen for the 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), writes in which language?
questions.explanation: Poet and lyricist Vairamuthu is the third Tamil writer to win the Jnanpith, after Akilan (1975) and Jayakanthan (2002). The Bharatiya Jnanpith announced the 60th award (for 2025) on 14 March 2026. The award carries Rs 11 lakh, a citation and a bronze statue of Vagdevi. Source: The Federal, 14 Mar 2026.

questions.q: Which institution won the European Parliament's Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought 2026?
questions.explanation: European Parliament President Roberta Metsola announced the award to the International Criminal Court on 22 October 2026. The ICC is based in The Hague. The prize is named after Soviet physicist Andrei Sakharov. Source: Al Jazeera, 22 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for his work on which observatory in Antarctica?
questions.explanation: Belgian-born Francis Halzen won for his work on IceCube, which uses Antarctic ice to detect neutrinos. The prize was announced on 6 October 2026. Each Nobel Prize in 2026 carries 12 million Swedish kronor. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2026 was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for work on:
questions.explanation: They won for light-gated ion channels and optogenetics, which uses light and genes to switch neurons on and off. The prize was announced on 5 October 2026. The other three options are the 2023, 2024 and 2025 topics. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026?
options: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
questions.explanation: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won for work on asymmetric synthesis of mirror-image molecules, which is used to make many drugs. The prize was announced on 7 October 2026. Source: AP, 12 Oct 2026.

questions.q: At the 72nd National Film Awards, the Best Actor award was shared by Kartik Aaryan ('Chandu Champion') and which other actor?
questions.explanation: Mammootty won for 'Bramayugam'. Yami Gautam won Best Actress for 'Article 370'. Source: News On AIR, 22 Sep 2026.

questions.q: At which place in Gujarat did the President present the 72nd National Film Awards on 22 September 2026?
questions.explanation: The ceremony was held near the Statue of Unity at Ekta Nagar instead of New Delhi. In all, 92 awardees were honoured. Source: News On AIR, 22 Sep 2026.

questions.q: Which veteran actor was awarded the Padma Vibhushan posthumously in the Padma Awards 2026?
questions.explanation: The 2026 list has 131 awards: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri. The other Padma Vibhushan awardees are V.S. Achuthanandan (posthumous), K.T. Thomas, N. Rajam and P. Narayanan. Banker Uday Kotak received the Padma Bhushan. Source: Adda247, 25 Jan 2026.

questions.q: Alan Greenspan, who died in June 2026 at the age of 100, was a former chairman of which central bank?
questions.explanation: Greenspan was the 13th Chair of the Federal Reserve, from 1987 to 2006. He succeeded Paul Volcker and was followed by Ben Bernanke. He died on 22 June 2026. Source: Al Jazeera, 22 Jun 2026.

questions.q: Teejan Bai, the Padma Vibhushan awardee who died in July 2026, was a famous performer of which folk art form?
questions.explanation: Teejan Bai performed Pandavani, the Chhattisgarh tradition of telling Mahabharata stories, in the Kapalik style. She died in Raipur on 5 July 2026. Source: The Federal, 6 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Actor Nana Patekar, who died in October 2026, won a National Film Award for his role as the gangster Anna in which 1989 film?
questions.explanation: Nana Patekar died in Goa on 8 October 2026, aged 75. He received the Padma Shri in 2013. His other films include Krantiveer and Welcome. Source: The Federal, 8 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who was awarded the Ashok Chakra, India's highest peacetime gallantry award, on Republic Day 2026?
questions.explanation: Shubhanshu Shukla was the first Indian to visit the International Space Station. Prashanth Balakrishnan Nair and Major Arshdeep Singh received the Kirti Chakra. Source: Adda247, 26 Jan 2026.

questions.q: Sir Garfield Sobers, who died in July 2026, played Test cricket for which team?
questions.explanation: The Barbados-born all-rounder played for the West Indies from 1954 to 1974 and died on 17 July 2026, aged 89. He scored 365 not out against Pakistan in 1958 and hit six sixes in an over in 1968. Source: Adda247, 18 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Who is the World Food Prize laureate for 2026, honoured at the prize's 40th anniversary ceremony in October 2026?
questions.explanation: Dutch food safety scientist Huub Lelieveld was named laureate in March 2026. The prize carries USD 500,000 and is given by the World Food Prize Foundation in Des Moines, Iowa. Source: Food Safety News, 27 Mar 2026.

questions.q: Which country topped the medal table at the 2026 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow?
questions.explanation: Australia finished first with 171 medals (70 gold, 45 silver, 56 bronze). England was second (29 gold) and Canada third (19 gold); India was fourth. Source: The Week, 2 Aug 2026.

questions.q: How many medals in total did India win at the 20th Asian Games 2026, where it finished fourth?
questions.explanation: India won 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze) and finished 4th, ahead of Uzbekistan on silver count. China, Japan and South Korea took the top three places. Source: News On AIR, 5 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Which Indian city will host the 2030 Commonwealth Games, the centenary edition of the Games?
questions.explanation: Glasgow handed the Games over to Ahmedabad (Amdavad) at the closing ceremony on 2 August 2026. It will be India's second Commonwealth Games after New Delhi 2010. Source: The Week, 2 Aug 2026.

questions.q: How many medals did Indian boxers win at the Asian Games 2026?
questions.explanation: India won six boxing medals: three gold (Lovlina Borgohain 75 kg, Parveen Hooda 65 kg, Ankush Panghal 80 kg) and three bronze. Three golds is India's best boxing gold tally at an Asian Games. Source: News On AIR, 5 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Which country finished first in the medal table of the Asian Games 2026?
questions.explanation: China topped the table with 341 medals, including 169 gold. Host Japan was second (83 gold) and South Korea third (39 gold); India was fourth with 21 gold. Source: Outlook India, Oct 2026.

questions.q: India won 39 medals at the 2026 Commonwealth Games. At which position did it finish in the medal table?
questions.explanation: India finished 4th with 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze. Host Scotland also had 13 gold and 39 medals but fewer silver, so it was 5th. Source: The Week, 2 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Which city received the Olympic Council of Asia flag in October 2026 as host of the next Asian Games in 2030?
questions.explanation: Doha (Qatar) will host the 21st Asian Games in 2030; it last hosted in 2006. Riyadh (Saudi Arabia) will host the 2034 edition. Source: Qatar News Agency, 4 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The 20th Asian Games were held from 19 September to 4 October 2026 in which Japanese host region?
questions.explanation: Aichi Prefecture and its capital Nagoya hosted the 20th Asian Games. Japan had earlier hosted the Games in Tokyo (1958) and Hiroshima (1994). The Games slogan was 'Imagine One Asia'. Source: Olympic Council of Asia.

questions.q: What is the name of the unicorn mascot of the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.explanation: Finnie, a unicorn (Scotland's national animal), was the Glasgow 2026 mascot. Perry was the Birmingham 2022 mascot, Borobi Gold Coast 2018 and Clyde Glasgow 2014. Source: Glasgow 2026 official website.

questions.q: What is the name of the official mascot of the Asian Games 2026?
questions.explanation: Honohon takes its name from 'honoho', an old Japanese word for flame. Miraitowa was the Tokyo 2020 Olympic mascot, Chenchen one of the Hangzhou Asian Games mascots and Bhin Bhin a Jakarta-Palembang 2018 mascot. Source: Olympic Council of Asia.

questions.q: Who was India's flag-bearer at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Commonwealth Games on 23 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu carried the flag and boxer Lovlina Borgohain was the baton-bearer at the OVO Hydro, Glasgow, where King Charles III opened the 23rd Games. Chanu later won India's first gold of the Games, in the women's 48 kg class. Source: News On AIR, 24 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup by beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final on 19 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute at the New York New Jersey (MetLife) Stadium to give Spain its second title after 2010. Rodri won the Golden Ball and France's Kylian Mbappe the Golden Boot with 10 goals. Source: Al Jazeera, 20 Jul 2026.

questions.q: In which sport did India win seven gold medals, its highest from any sport, at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.explanation: Indian boxers won 10 medals (7 gold, 3 silver), India's best boxing show at a Commonwealth Games. Gold winners included Preeti Pawar, Jaismine Lamboria, Sakshi Chaudhary, Priya Ghanghas, Arundhati Choudhary, Sachin Siwach and Ankush Panghal. Source: The Week, 2 Aug 2026.

questions.q: The Indian women's hockey team won its first Asian Games gold since 1982 by beating which country 1-0 in the final in October 2026?
questions.explanation: Lalremsiami scored the only goal against China. The men's team beat Malaysia 5-1 to keep its title, and both teams qualified for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. Source: News On AIR, 5 Oct 2026.

questions.q: India retained the men's cricket gold medal at the Asian Games 2026 by beating which team in the final?
questions.explanation: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs. The Indian women's team also retained its gold, beating Sri Lanka by 147 runs. Afghanistan was the losing finalist at Hangzhou. Source: News On AIR, 5 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The scaled-down 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow featured how many sports?
questions.explanation: Glasgow 2026 had 10 sports, nine fewer than Birmingham 2022; hockey, wrestling, shooting, badminton, table tennis and cricket were among those left out. Athletes from 74 nations and territories took part. Source: News On AIR, 24 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Which team won the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2026, beating hosts England in the final at Lord's on 5 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Australia won by seven wickets for a record seventh Women's T20 World Cup title. Beth Mooney was player of the final. Source: ICC, 5 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Which Mercedes driver became the youngest Formula 1 World Champion by sealing the 2026 title at the Mexico City Grand Prix on 1 November 2026?
questions.explanation: Italy's Kimi Antonelli, aged 20, clinched his first title by finishing third in Mexico City; Max Verstappen won the race. Lando Norris was the 2025 champion. Source: Formula1.com, 1 Nov 2026.

questions.q: Who won the men's Ballon d'Or 2026, announced in October 2026?
questions.explanation: England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane won his first Ballon d'Or, ahead of Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal; he also took the Gerd Muller Trophy. Spain's Alexia Putellas won the women's award for the third time. Source: ESPN, Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2026?
questions.explanation: Italy's Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev in four sets for his second straight Wimbledon title and fifth Grand Slam. Linda Noskova of Czechia won the women's singles. Source: News On AIR, 13 Jul 2026.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at the US Open 2026, beating Ben Shelton in the final?
questions.explanation: Germany's Alexander Zverev won in four sets on 13 September 2026 for his second Grand Slam of the year after the French Open. Elena Rybakina beat Aryna Sabalenka for the women's title. Source: Associated Press, 13 Sep 2026.

questions.q: Which country won the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2026, beating Spain 1-0 in the final on 30 August 2026?
questions.explanation: Germany retained the title for its fourth World Cup; the final was at Wavre, Belgium. Belgium and the Netherlands co-hosted, and Argentina won the women's title. Source: News On AIR, 30 Aug 2026.

questions.q: Which of the following Asian Games 2026 gold medallist and sport pairs is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Pranavi Urs won the women's individual golf gold. Aman Sehrawat won gold in wrestling, Parveen Hooda in boxing (65 kg) and Kumkum Mohod in recurve archery. Source: Outlook India, Oct 2026.

questions.q: Which city is the venue of the FIDE World Chess Championship Match 2026 between D. Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov, scheduled from 24 November 2026?
questions.explanation: The match is at the Fondation Martin Bodmer, Cologny, Geneva, Switzerland: opening ceremony on 22 November, first game on 24 November and tie-breaks (if needed) on 12 December 2026, with a prize fund of USD 2.5 million over 14 classical games. D. Gukesh is the defending champion; Javokhir Sindarov of Uzbekistan won the Candidates 2026. The result will not be known before mid-December. Source: FIDE, 14 Sep 2026.

questions.q: Who were India's flag-bearers at the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2026 on 19 September 2026?
options: Tajinderpal Singh Toor and Mirabai Chanu
questions.explanation: Shooter Manu Bhaker and kabaddi player Pawan Sehrawat led India; Sehrawat replaced shot putter Tajinderpal Singh Toor, who was named first. Shooter Neeru Dhanda carried the flag at the closing ceremony. Source: Indian Olympic Association via Adda247, 19 Sep 2026; Wikipedia.

questions.q: Which city hosted the 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games, the first Olympic event held in Africa?
questions.explanation: Dakar, Senegal, hosted the 4th Summer Youth Olympic Games from 31 October to 13 November 2026. The previous edition was in Buenos Aires in 2018. Source: Wikipedia (2026 Summer Youth Olympics), citing Olympics.com.

questions.q: Which of the following trophy and sport pairs is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is the men's world team badminton championship. The Davis Cup is tennis, the Durand Cup is football and the Ranji Trophy is cricket. Source: BWF.

questions.q: Which of the following sports term and sport pairs is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: A bully is used to restart play in hockey. LBW belongs to cricket, checkmate to chess and birdie to golf. Source: FIH Rules of Hockey.

questions.q: Which city will host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: Los Angeles hosts the 2028 Games, where cricket returns to the Olympics. Brisbane will host in 2032; Paris hosted in 2024. Source: International Olympic Committee.

questions.q: Which three countries will co-host the 2030 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Morocco, Portugal and Spain will host in 2030, with three centenary matches in Uruguay, Argentina and Paraguay. Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 World Cup. Source: FIFA, Dec 2024.

questions.q: Which countries will co-host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2027?
questions.explanation: The 2027 ODI World Cup will be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. India and Bangladesh will co-host the 2031 edition. Source: ICC.

questions.q: Where is the headquarters of the International Cricket Council (ICC)?
questions.explanation: The ICC moved its headquarters from Lord's, London, to Dubai in 2005. FIFA is based in Zurich, the IOC in Lausanne and the BCCI in Mumbai. Source: ICC.
